```{r}
# STEP 0 - Output setup
out_dir <- "../output/OLS"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "summary.txt")

```

```{r}
# STEP 1 - Clean Data Loading 

# 1.1 Load data
df_clean <- read.csv("../data/processed/listings_cleaned.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# 1.2 Convert relevant variables to factor
df_clean$room_type <- as.factor(df_clean$room_type)
df_clean$property_type <- as.factor(df_clean$property_type)
df_clean$property_type <- relevel(df_clean$property_type, ref = "Apartment")
df_clean$neighbourhood_cleansed <- as.factor(df_clean$neighbourhood_cleansed)
df_clean$instant_bookable <- as.factor(df_clean$instant_bookable)
df_clean$cancellation_policy <- as.factor(df_clean$cancellation_policy)
df_clean$host_is_superhost <- as.factor(df_clean$host_is_superhost)
df_clean$host_identity_verified <- as.factor(df_clean$host_identity_verified)

# 1.3 Lump rare property_type levels
prop_counts <- table(df_clean$property_type)

rare_levels <- names(prop_counts[prop_counts < 20])

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    property_type = ifelse(property_type %in% rare_levels,
                           "Other",
                           property_type),
    property_type = as.factor(property_type)
  )

```

```{r}
# STEP 2 - OLS: Kitchen Sink Model (Benchmark)

library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(car)

sink(out_file)
cat("=========================================\n")
cat("OLS Modeling Report\n")
cat("Generated:", format(Sys.time()), "\n")
cat("=========================================\n\n")

cat("=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 1 — Data Check\n")
cat("=========================================\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(df_clean), " | Cols:", ncol(df_clean), "\n\n")
cat("number_of_reviews summary:\n")
print(summary(df_clean$number_of_reviews))
cat("\n\n")

cat("=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 2 — Kitchen Sink OLS (log1p(Y))\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

model_kitchen <- lm(
  log1p(number_of_reviews) ~
    log_price + extra_people + guests_included +
    room_type + accommodates + bedrooms + bathrooms + beds +
    property_type + neighbourhood_cleansed +
    host_is_superhost + host_response_rate + host_acceptance_rate +
    host_identity_verified + minimum_nights + instant_bookable +
    cancellation_policy + review_scores_rating +
    log_host_listings_count + amenities_count + host_response_time_ord +
    distance_to_center_km,
  data = df_clean
)

cat("\n--- OLS summary (kitchen) ---\n")
print(summary(model_kitchen))

cat("\n--- Robust SE (HC1) (kitchen) ---\n")
print(coeftest(model_kitchen, vcov = vcovHC(model_kitchen, type = "HC1")))

```

```{r}
# STEP 3 - OLS: Clean Model (Reduced Specification)

cat("\n\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 3 — Clean OLS (log1p(Y))\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

model_clean <- lm(
  log1p(number_of_reviews) ~
    log_price + accommodates + room_type + property_type +
    distance_to_center_km + neighbourhood_cleansed +
    amenities_count + minimum_nights + instant_bookable +
    host_is_superhost + host_response_rate + 
    log_host_listings_count,
  data = df_clean
)

cat("\n--- OLS summary (clean) ---\n")
print(summary(model_clean))

cat("\n--- Robust SE (HC1) (clean) ---\n")
print(coeftest(model_clean, vcov = vcovHC(model_clean, type = "HC1")))

```

```{r}
# STEP 4 - Comparison & Diagnostics

cat("\n\n=========================================\n")
cat("STEP 4 — Comparison & Diagnostics\n")
cat("=========================================\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4.1 Same-sample comparison (use kitchen's estimation sample)
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Build same-sample dataset for BOTH models
vars_needed <- unique(c(
  all.vars(formula(model_kitchen)),
  all.vars(formula(model_clean))
))

df_same_sample <- df_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(vars_needed)) %>%
  na.omit()

model_kitchen_same_sample <- lm(formula(model_kitchen), data = df_same_sample)
model_clean_same_sample   <- lm(formula(model_clean),   data = df_same_sample)

cat("\n--- Same-sample fit comparison ---\n")
cat("Adj R^2 (kitchen):", summary(model_kitchen)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("Adj R^2 (clean, same sample):", summary(model_clean_same_sample)$adj.r.squared, "\n\n")

cat("log_price (kitchen):", coef(model_kitchen)["log_price"], "\n")
cat("log_price (clean, same sample):", coef(model_clean_same_sample)["log_price"], "\n\n")

cat("--- AIC / BIC (same sample) ---\n")
print(AIC(model_kitchen, model_clean_same_sample))
print(BIC(model_kitchen, model_clean_same_sample))

cat("\n--- Block significance test (partial F-test) ---\n")
print(anova(model_clean_same_sample, model_kitchen))

cat("\n--- VIF (kitchen) ---\n")
print(vif(model_kitchen))

# Close sink for the report
while (sink.number() > 0) sink()

# =========================================================
# STEP 5 - Residual diagnostics plots
# =========================================================
png(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "residual_plots_kitchen.png"),
  width = 1200, height = 900
)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model_kitchen)
dev.off()

```
